name: Gray Virus
source:
It was summer. College senior Mikoto still couldn't tell Sakuya how he felt. 
The four men met quite by accident at HERMIT, a strangely overlooked tea cafe. 
Such a conspicuous meeting was surely guided by the hand of fate---
Can Mikoto rescue Sakuya......? 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE174138.html]DLsite English[/url]]
